synopsis: Q: Why did you choose this high school? A: Because my future wife is enrolling here. When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past. Standing before me was Arisugawa Yuki, my future wife, wearing a school uniform I don't recognize. In the original timeline, we wouldn't meet until we became adults and eventually got married, so we're still strangers for now. But I know that she distrusts people, has no friends, and spends her school days alone. I also know she'll deeply regret that time in the future. So this time, I'm going to rewrite her youth. synopsis: The original story is set a few years after dungeons began appearing in the modern world. Karin Yamada is a "dungeon streamer," a new kind of streamer who live streams their expeditions in the dungeon. Though she has adopted the character of a classy rich lady, with zero views and three subscribers, she is decidedly obscure, and depressed about it. One day, she stumbles on an adventurer trying to stir up trouble for views by causing an explosion in a dungeon. Karin immediately leaps into action and stops it by beating up the adventurer. Little did she know that the adventurer was also streaming to a wide audience, who all saw her beating up and lecturing the adventurer. The incident propels her to overnight popularity. (Source: Anime News Network)

synopsis: Sota Kitaoka, born in Shizunai, Hokkaido, to a family that ran a restaurant called "Kitaoka", moved to Tokyo for training in order to rebuild his family's run-down restaurant. There, he was discovered by the owner of "Tomikyu," a long-established ryotei restaurant in Ginza, where he underwent rigorous training, eventually becoming the head chef at Tomikyu. After that, he went on a culinary journey until he opened his own restaurant, "Tomikyu Kamui" in Nerima, Tokyo. A few years later, Sota is back at it again, this time to pursue the essence of "Omotenashi" (hospitality), just in time for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics! The long-awaited revival of the classic culinary manga! (Source: Bunkasha, translated)
